project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript, Neon PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, Better Auth, Flutter mobile app
build_system: npm with Next.js, no separate build command needed for dev
test_framework: No test framework configured in package.json. Manual testing required.
test_command: Manual testing via npm run dev and accessing routes. No automated test suite found.
verification_instructions:
1. Start dev server: npm run dev
2. Apply schema changes: npm run db:push
3. Test API endpoints using browser/Postman
4. Verify database changes using Drizzle Studio or direct SQL
5. Check email delivery in logs (nodemailer configured with SMTP)
6. Verify mobile endpoints with Flutter app or Postman with Bearer tokens
snapshot_or_generated_files: null. No generated files to commit. Database migrations handled via drizzle-kit push.
environment_constraints:
1. SMTP email may not be configured (graceful failure required)
2. Never modify lib/auth-config.ts directly - Better Auth config in lib/auth/server.ts
3. Better Auth uses bearer plugin for mobile token validation
4. Database uses Neon serverless PostgreSQL with RLS policies
5. Google OAuth requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET env vars
contribution_requirements:
1. Follow existing patterns from lib/middleware/permissions.ts for RBAC
2. Reuse existing email.ts utility for notifications
3. Use Better Auth's native session management (no custom JWT)
4. Apply schema changes with npm run db:push
5. Maintain DRY principle - reuse getUserCenterId(), requireDoctor() patterns
6. Handle email failures gracefully (log and continue, create notification as fallback)
key_patterns:
1. RBAC: requireDoctor(), requireCenter(), requireAdmin() from lib/middleware/permissions.ts
2. Auth: getAuthenticatedUser() returns full user with role
3. Email: sendEmail() from lib/email.ts, returns boolean (false if SMTP not configured)
4. API routes: return NextResponse.json() with error/success
5. Database: Drizzle ORM with schema in db/schema.ts
6. Session: Better Auth with bearer plugin for mobile
7. Mobile: Bearer token in Authorization header, device ID in X-Device-ID header
relevant_files: db/schema.ts (users, doctors, centers, bookings, sessions, accounts, verifications tables)
lib/auth-config.ts (Better Auth export, do NOT modify providers here)
directory_structure:
app/: Next.js app directory with api/, admin/, center/, patient/, doctor/ (to create), auth/ subdirs
lib/: Shared utilities (auth/, middleware/, email.ts)
db/: Drizzle schema and database client
mobile/: Flutter mobile app with lib/features/ structure
components/: React components by role (admin/, center/, patient/, doctor/ to create)
